checkpoints.private boxes: the 2026-09-05 release-candidate split (loudr-1 fb229147…, loudr-1-turbo 1c8afc56…): the same tensors, a manifest header without edge_fade_seconds; the fade is applied after the vocoder and does not enter the timing

method: tools/bench.py per (box, model, mode): three passages, seed 7, voice joe; the docs quote the third passage (48 words), warm run. research/bench_batch.py per (box, model): 255-token windows decoded in lockstep with CUDA graphs, token generator only, aggregate audio per wall-clock second. Cloud boxes ran gcp_gpu_bench_011.sh as their startup script; the 3090 and the Jetson ran the same commands over ssh.
